"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports all efforts toward fostering understanding and cooperation among persons and groups of differing sexual orientations and gender identities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
